note: GAMEPLAY SETTINGS (provisional balance values, not historical measurements). What a soldier class is on the battlefield: its kit, its firelock's accuracy over distance, the range its squads prefer, and its one verb. Read only through Battle/PA250UnitClasses (Unreal); the sim never reads these values. The class ids are the campaign's Army.units keys. prefer_min_m / prefer_max_m: the squad opens fire inside the far figure and closes to the near one. accurate_m: beyond it the aim cone widens by spread_growth for every further accurate_m. ticket_cost: reserve tickets a death costs. capture_weight: how much one man counts at a post.

verbs.note: Values of the class verbs. A class takes part in one when its kit sets the matching flag (volley_shock, steady_in_cover, officer_hunter, charge_routs, forward_spawn, rallies, takes_prisoners).

squad.note: The player's own file. He always leads file_min to file_max men of his class, taken from the men on the field (made up with other men when his class has too few). follow_behind_m: on 'Follow me' the line forms this far behind him. line_ahead_m: 'Form line here' puts it this far in front. order_seconds: how long a squad that is not his own file obeys an officer's order before it judges for itself again. aim_snap_m: the enemy this close to the point he aims at is his target; aim_ray_m: so is the nearest enemy this close to the line he is looking along. ensure_seconds: how often the file is made up again from the field.

sapper.note: build_seconds: one sapper's labour raises a whole breastwork in this long (a redoubt takes longer in proportion to its strength); several sappers share the work. reach_m: he works on a place this close. seek_m: a bot sapper goes to a place that needs him within this distance, on ground his side holds. burst_seconds: the player's T gives this much labour at a time, feet planted.

ensign.note: The colours. radius_m / rally_scale: a routing squad within radius_m of its side's flying colours needs rally_scale of the usual calm to rally. When the ensign falls the colours fall with him and his side takes a morale check (colours_fall_pressure, fading over colours_fall_seconds); the same when they are carried off. A man within pickup_m of fallen colours takes them up (a friend) or, standing over them capture_seconds, carries them off (an enemy); bots within seek_m go for them. Colours carried off are reported in BattleResult.colours_captured.

musician.note: relay_m: an order heard by a musician (he must be within the giver's own order radius) carries on to every friendly line within relay_m of him; this is the only way a leader who is not an officer reaches squads other than his own file. cadence_m / cadence_reload_scale: men who fire by volley within cadence_m of a musician load in cadence_reload_scale of the usual time.

surgeon.note: A fallen man can be saved for window_seconds after he falls. A surgeon within seek_m runs to him and, staying within reach_m for treat_seconds, saves him: he is reported wounded, not killed, whatever the casualty ratio says.

line_infantry.label: Regular
line_infantry.blurb: The battalion man. Steady in the volley and in the charge.
line_infantry.role: Line infantry: stands in ranks at 30 to 60 m and fires by volley.
line_infantry.verb: Volley: three or more in rank firing within a second shakes the squad they fire on.

grenadier.label: Grenadier
grenadier.blurb: Shock troops: the biggest men of the regiment. Deadliest with the bayonet; a ball stops them like any man.
grenadier.role: Shock troops: hold their fire and close to under 25 m.
grenadier.verb: Charge: a grenadier bayonet charge that reaches a squad forces it to check or break.

light_infantry.label: Light Infantry
light_infantry.blurb: Skirmishers in loose order. Fast and a better shot; lighter in a bayonet fight.
light_infantry.role: Skirmishers: loose order at 50 to 90 m, using cover.
light_infantry.verb: Seize the ground: takes a post faster than any other man, and may come on at a post close to the enemy.

officer.label: Officer
officer.blurb: Leads from the line: men within 15 m of him aim steadier and load faster.
officer.role: Leader: men within 15 m of him aim steadier and load faster.
officer.verb: Rally: stops a routing squad nearby (30 s between rallies), and orders the nearest line to volley or charge.

dragoon.label: Dragoon
dragoon.blurb: Mounted infantry. Rides to the fight, dismounts out of range and fights on foot; remounts to move. H mounts and dismounts.
dragoon.role: Mounted infantry: rides to the fight, dismounts out of musket range and fights on foot.
dragoon.verb: Ride them down: routing enemies he overtakes in the saddle surrender as prisoners.

sapper.label: Pioneer
sapper.blurb: The regiment's pioneers: they throw up earth where the line must stand, and fight with it when the work is done.
sapper.role: Field works: builds and mends breastworks at the places marked for them, on ground his side holds.
sapper.verb: Dig in: T at a marked place raises the work; a bank he has raised stops a ball.

ensign.label: Ensign
ensign.blurb: Carries the colours. Men rally to them; if they fall, the whole side feels it.
ensign.role: Colour bearer: squads near the colours rally in half the time, and his squad's replacements come on beside him.
ensign.verb: The colours: if he falls they fall with him and his side takes a morale check; taken by the enemy they are his trophy.

musician.label: Drummer
musician.blurb: Beats the orders down the line and keeps the loading in time.
musician.role: Signals: an order he hears carries on to every line within 40 m of him.
musician.verb: Cadence: men who fire by volley load a little faster within 15 m of him.

surgeon.label: Surgeon
surgeon.blurb: Goes to the men who fall. Those he reaches in time live.
surgeon.role: Field surgeon: runs to a fallen man within 50 m of him.
surgeon.verb: Saves the fallen: a man he reaches within 25 s and tends for 4 s is wounded, not killed.

artilleryman.label: Royal Artilleryman
artilleryman.weapon: Short musket; serves a field gun
artilleryman.blurb: A blue coat among the red. His gun breaks a breastwork at three hundred yards and a charge at seventy.
artilleryman.role: Gun crew: goes to one of his side's field guns and works it. Four men serve a gun; two can still work it, slowly.
artilleryman.verb: Serves a gun: T at a gun of your side takes your place. It lays where you look, your trigger fires it, R works the drill.

line_infantry.label: Provincial
line_infantry.blurb: Enlisted men who stand in ranks and volley. Steadier than militia in the open.
line_infantry.role: Line infantry: stands in ranks at 30 to 60 m and fires by volley.
line_infantry.verb: Volley: three or more in rank firing within a second shakes the squad they fire on.

militia.label: Militia
militia.blurb: Minutemen and militia. Best from walls and fences; fragile in the open and hand to hand.
militia.role: Irregulars: fire at will at 40 to 70 m from walls and fences.
militia.verb: Home ground: steady and a truer shot behind cover, quickly shaken in the open; a militiaman lost costs half a ticket.

rifleman.label: Rifleman
rifleman.blurb: Marksman. Kills at twice a musket's range, but loads slowly and is weak hand to hand.
rifleman.role: Marksman: picks his man at 100 to 200 m and keeps his distance.
rifleman.verb: Pick off the officer: an officer killed by a rifleman leaves his squad shaken.
